title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Niemann Wins LIV Playoff
items.text: Joaquin Niemann captured his eighth LIV Golf title by winning a playoff against Talor Gooch in South Korea, marking the most LIV wins by any player since 2022 amid LIV's funding uncertainty.

items.headline: Potgieter Breaks NCAA Bogey-Free Record
items.text: Louisiana's Malan Potgieter extended his NCAA Championship bogey-free streak to 91 holes, surpassing the previous record of 74 and closing in on Tiger Woods’ professional mark of 110.
